) said on Friday that it will terminate its previously announced non-brokered private placement offerings after raising aggregate gross proceeds of C$416,220.
The offerings terminated were announced on June 2, 2026; July 21, 2026; August 26, 2026; and October 1, 2026.

Following a review of its financing requirements and strategic alternatives, the company determined not to proceed with any additional tranches of the offering, as it is evaluating alternative financing opportunities that it believes may be more suitable for its current objectives, Seegnal said.
The company also launched a new non-brokered private placement of up to 1M units for gross proceeds of up to C$1.5M, at a price of $0.15 per unit.
Each unit is comprised of one common share and one common share purchase warrant.
Each warrant is exercisable to acquire one common share at a price of C$0.25 for a period of 36 months from the applicable closing date.
The company added that it will use the proceeds from the new offering for general corporate and working capital purposes.
All securities issued under the new offering will be subject to a hold period expiring four months and one day from the date of issuance.
The offering is expected to close in one or more tranches on or before December 31, 2026.

title: Seegnal terminates older non-brokered private placements, launches new offering
